Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
Our cloud segment grew 8% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 120 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 120 basis points to 38.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $5.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Revenue guidance of $2.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
